mapper.insert: insert into good(name, category_id,imgs,description, create_time) value (#{good.name},#{good.categoryId},#{good.imgs}, #{good.description},#{good.createTime})
mapper.update: update `good` set sales = sales + #{count} ,sale_money = sale_money + #{money} where good.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT good.*,MIN(good_standard.price) as price FROM `good` LEFT JOIN good_standard on good.gid = good_standard.gid WHERE is_delete = 0 AND recommend = 1 GROUP BY id ORDER BY price ASC
